portal.preferencias_intro: Customise this session and save your choices for future visits.
portal.preferencias_error: Your preferences could not be loaded. No saved settings are shown.
portal.preferencias_denegado: Your session is not permitted to view these preferences.
portal.preferencias_sesion: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
portal.preferencias_no_guardadas: Catalogue defaults are shown. You have no saved preferences yet.
portal.preferencias_visual_sub: Options for reading and navigating VEC.
portal.preferencias_navegacion_sub: Your home page opens only if you can access it.
portal.preferencias_avisos_sub: These choices do not confirm that email has been sent.
portal.preferencias_ayuda_idioma: The current URL language takes priority for this visit. Your saved preference follows, then your browser language.
portal.preferencias_ayuda_tamano: You can also enlarge the page with browser zoom.
portal.preferencias_ayuda_contraste: High contrast takes priority over theme colours.
portal.preferencias_ayuda_tema: System follows your device colour setting.
portal.preferencias_ayuda_inicio: If you cannot access the selected destination, the safe home page opens with a notice.
portal.preferencias_ayuda_filas: This choice applies to supported local tables. Remote queries retain their own limits.
portal.preferencias_ayuda_correo_tareas: Saving this choice does not confirm any email delivery.
portal.preferencias_ayuda_correo_plazos: Saving this choice does not confirm any email delivery.
portal.preferencias_idioma_guardado: Your saved language will apply when you reload the portal without a language in the URL.
portal.preferencias_conflicto: Your preferences changed in another session. Load the current version before saving again.
portal.preferencias_validacion: The server rejected an option. Review the updated catalogue.
portal.preferencias_error_guardar: Saving could not be confirmed. Load your preferences before retrying; the change may have been applied.
portal.preferencias_tope: This list has a limit of {limite} rows although your preference is {preferidas}.
portal.preferencias_destino_no_disponible: You cannot access the selected home page. The portal home page has opened.
portal.preferencias_atajo_texto_activo: Text size increased for this session.
portal.preferencias_atajo_texto_inactivo: Normal text size for this session.
portal.preferencias_atajo_contraste_activo: High contrast enabled for this session.
portal.preferencias_atajo_contraste_inactivo: High contrast disabled for this session.

areaPersonal.areaPersonal.preferencias.subtitulo: Personal options stored by the authorised service
areaPersonal.areaPersonal.preferencias.sinDatos: Your preferences could not be retrieved. No value is shown as saved.
areaPersonal.areaPersonal.preferencias.incierto: The outcome could not be confirmed. You may repeat this exact operation with the same key; no different request will be sent.
areaPersonal.areaPersonal.preferencias.inicioAjeno: The selected start page belongs to another area or is not authorised here. The safe Personal Area home page opens. This choice does not grant access.
areaPersonal.areaPersonal.preferencias.avisosLimite: Email alerts are preferences stored here; they do not establish that an email was sent or delivered. Row count applies only to compatible local lists.
areaPersonal.areaPersonal.preferencias.ayuda: A language in the URL takes priority for this visit only. Otherwise your saved choice is used, then the browser language. High contrast takes priority over the colour theme. The start page does not change your permissions. A receipt confirms saving these options, not sending alerts.
areaPersonal.areaPersonal.preferencias.error.autentic: Your identification has expired. Identify yourself again to view or save preferences.
areaPersonal.areaPersonal.preferencias.error.denegado: You do not have permission to view or save your preferences.
areaPersonal.areaPersonal.preferencias.error.conflict: The preferences or catalogue have changed. Refresh before saving again.
areaPersonal.areaPersonal.preferencias.error.validaci: Check the options: the service rejected a value.
areaPersonal.areaPersonal.preferencias.error.servicio: The preferences service is unavailable. The outcome of the last attempt cannot be confirmed.
areaPersonal.areaPersonal.preferencias.error.respuest: The service returned an incompatible response. No change is confirmed.
areaPersonal.areaPersonal.preferencias.identidadServi: Identity verified by the Users service
areaPersonal.areaPersonal.preferencias.identidadNoCon: Identity not confirmed by the preferences service
